{{Quote|Captain, make for the ''Bogden'' system. We can make repairs&mdash;at the Jedi training facility there. Provided the ship can reach it.|[[K'Kruhk]], to a [[Unidentified clone trooper captain (Order 66)|clone captain]]|<ref name="Dark Times 6">[[Dark Times 6|''Dark Times'' 6]]</ref>}}
The '''Bogden system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]].

The Bogden system was known as a notable [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-[[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] system.<ref name="TEA" />
